source.title: Report and Analysis of the P.R. Urban Elections in Ulster held on 15 January 1920 (Ulster Committee of the Proportional Representation Society of Ireland, 1920), Ormeau Ward results sheet; reprinted in PR Urban Elections in Ulster, 1920 (Electoral Reform Society, London, 1972), pp. 24-25, and the ward summary on p. 37
source.publisher: Proportional Representation Society of Ireland (Ulster Committee); reprinted by the Electoral Reform Society of Great Britain and Ireland
source.check: every stage transcribed by eye from the printed results sheet; every count adds to the printed valid vote, each result is the previous result plus the printed transfer, the quota is the valid vote divided by one more than the seats, plus one, and the party first-preference totals match the ward summary

note: First election by proportional representation (single transferable vote) under the Local Government (Ireland) Act 1919, on the nine wards that replaced the fifteen of 1896. Polled 15 January 1920 and counted on 16 and 17 January. The ward returned 6 members: 1 alderman and 5 councillors.
